lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: genitive masculine plural (form V) active participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ is in the derivative form: مُتَوَسِّمِين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/س/م   w–s–m brand, sign, branding iron; to cauterise; good looks; seasons, returning occasions, spring rain; to see signs of certain traits in someone, to gauge; to ornament. Of this root, 2 forms, نَسِمُ nasim and مُتَوَسِّمُون mutawassimūn, occur 1 time each in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُتَوَسِّمِين mutawassimın [pl. of act. part. مُتَوَسِّم mutawassim] one who infers, uses clues to read the signs

(15:75) إِنَّ فِى ذَلِكَ لآَيَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ there is truly a lesson in this for those who read the signs.

entries.label: نَسِمُ
entries.definitionHtml:
نَسِمُ nasim [imperf. of v. وَسَمَ wasama, trans.] to brand

(68:16) سَنَسِمُهُ عَلَى الْخُرْطُومِ We will brand him on the snout.
